title: Detect Fall Negative
text: Detect falling edge when signal value decreases to strictly negative value, and its previous value was nonnegative, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Initial condition} sets Initial condition for the previous input; {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements and {Output data type} sets the data type. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: Initial condition for the previous input 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of the output boolean (default) | uint8
